title: Soft, that's it.
text: Soft, that's it.. It's definitely soft. But I should have looked at how thick it was. Because it doesn't really make much of a difference on my bed.

product_metadata.title: Comfy Bedding Ultrasoft Microplush Mattress Pad Topper (King, White)
features: Mattress pad sewn with soft microplush fabric and overfilled for extra comfort
Overfilled with loft-retaining, polyester filling for extra comfort
End-to-end box stitched with mitered border to prevent fill from shifting
Deep pockets fit mattresses up to 18 inches deep and allow the mattress pad to double as a mattress protector for all-in-one convenience
TWIN size: 39" × 75"; TWIN XL size: 39" × 80"; FULL size: 54" × 75", QUEEN size: 60" × 80"; KING size: 78" × 80"; CALI KING size: 72"x 84"
description: Our mattress pad features a blend of generous fill and super-soft fabric to add a cloudlike surface to the bed. Comparable to down in its softness, the pad is made from microplush fabric with a sumptuous hand and stuffed with loft-retaining polyester fill. An end-to-end box stitch design ensures even distribution of the fill, and mitered borders prevent shifting and flat spots. Sewn with deep pockets and a fully elasticized edge, the pad doubles as a mattress topper and a mattress protector, and it fits even deep mattresses like pillow-tops. Designed to go in the washer and dryer for simple care, it comes in twin, twin XL, full, queen, king, and California king.
